target.title: fix: skip unavailable skill installers during onboarding
target.body:
﻿## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running beta onboarding on a fresh Linux/VPS install could see a wall of optional skill dependency failures immediately after setup when local installer prerequisites were not ready. The observed onboarding transcript selected Telegram and DuckDuckGo, then the skill dependency step attempted optional brew-, Go-, and uv-backed recipes even though Homebrew was missing, Go was too old for newer module directives, and uv was not installed.

AI-assisted: yes, authored with Codex.

## Why This Change Was Made

The onboarding skill step now splits trusted bundled skill recipes into ready-to-run installs and recipes that need a local installer prerequisite first. Brew recipes are skipped when Homebrew is unavailable, uv recipes are skipped unless uv or Homebrew can handle them, and Go recipes require a usable Go 1.21+ toolchain unless Homebrew can bootstrap a missing Go install. Node-backed skill installs continue to run, and the skipped optional skills are grouped into one manual-prerequisites note instead of failing one by one.

## User Impact

Fresh onboarding stays calmer and more actionable on Linux/VPS hosts. Users can finish setup without noisy optional dependency failures, then install Homebrew, uv, or a modern Go toolchain later and run `openclaw doctor` to revisit skill requirements.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/commands/onboard-skills.test.ts src/wizard/i18n/index.test.ts`
- `corepack pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/commands/onboard-skills.ts src/commands/onboard-skills.test.ts src/wizard/i18n/locales/en.ts src/wizard/i18n/locales/zh-CN.ts src/wizard/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts`
- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/commands/onboard-skills.ts src/commands/onboard-skills.test.ts src/wizard/i18n/locales/en.ts src/wizard/i18n/locales/zh-CN.ts src/wizard/i18n/locales/zh-TW.ts`
- `node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test.tsbuildinfo`
